## Reproducibility

If results changed, provide the experiment configuration, seed policy, model/runtime settings, run identifier, and before/after metrics or artifact locations.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and contains no unrelated modifications.
- [ ] New behavior is covered by tests where practical.
- [ ] No credentials, confidential data, or proprietary datasets are included.
- [ ] Limitations or threats to validity are documented when applicable.
